ERC-8441 (schemeId 3) fixes discovery. articles.title: Paths to post-quantum execution in Hegotá: an experimental comparison

articles.title: A state-backed validation of SETCODEFROM
articles.excerpt: We tested the draft of EIP-8298 against mainnet bytecode. The conclusion? It needs two new rules: why, and at what cost. SETCODEFROM points an account’s code hash at code another contract already deployed. The draft was generous: any account could adopt, as often as it liked, from any code running on its behalf, and the new code showed up the instant the instruction ran. That generosity is what the menu of account modes was built on, and it is where the trouble was. We ran the worst cases against bytecode that is on mainnet today: two things broke, and each gets a rule in the change we propose. Nothing is at risk now.
